title: AMC 10 Practice: Counting On-Off Grid Patterns — How Many?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on counting light patterns with a full row or column, solved by counting the losers and by inclusion and exclusion. (Level 4 of 5)
Nine lights, each on or off. How many patterns have a full row or a full column? Count the losers, then check it with inclusion and exclusion, learn to spot the overlap traps, and try a variant on your own.
